description: Generate SMS marketing message variants from a prompt. Nothing is created or sent; the first generation for a company also saves its inferred email design direction, which later generations reuse. Returns plain-text messages with per-message encoding and segment counts. Use the results as the 'text' of an SMS sequence step (insert_sequence_step with type 'sms' or a create_sequence sms step). Messages exclude opt-out footers and brand prefixes - the platform adds those automatically at send time.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

count.description: Number of message variants to generate (default: 3, max: 10)

prompt.description: Description of the SMS to generate (e.g., 'cart reminder with a free-shipping hook')

name: generate_sms

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `generate_sms` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

messages.description: Generated SMS message variants with encoding and segment counts.

prompt.description: The prompt the messages were generated for.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
